findings.description: PCHIP preserves monotonicity only between knots. Cubic extrapolation could produce negative ATM variance slopes outside fitted expiries.
findings.fix: Shared positive linear ATM tails for direct prices and Dupire derivatives.

findings.description: Uniform cell-area weights applied to all boundary nodes inflated magnitude/potential integrals on coarse grids.
findings.fix: Trapezoidal nodal and midpoint/transverse-trapezoidal edge quadrature.

findings.description: Original fixed domain [-1,1], uniform times and quote-dependent max maturity were unsuitable for the wider/longer literature inputs.
findings.fix: Dedicated fixed-grid solver with clustered states, exact quote-time knots, startup damping and refined-grid/domain repricing.

findings.description: Original market SSVI fit used soft finite-grid constraints and allowed gamma above 0.5, without a global butterfly guarantee.
findings.fix: The new controlled benchmark uses the same conservatively constrained SSVI price fit for all penalty methods. Historical fitter retained as a legacy implementation.

findings.description: The historical expiry diagnostic reused a lambda previously chosen on the same market panel.
findings.fix: Each new outer fold refits SSVI and independently tunes its penalty on an inner split.

findings.description: With a taper q, the latent correction amplitude h is not the actual log-variance deviation: u-u_ref=q*h. The implemented penalty is h^T R h, not (q*h)^T R (q*h).
findings.fix: Retained the final Stage 18 specification and state the latent-amplitude objective explicitly; Neumann regularizer behavior is distinct from taper and price-PDE boundaries.

preserved_intended_features: penalty on the total latent correction
